name: weather_check
description: Checks the current world weather state such as raining or thundering.

name: time_check
description: Checks the current day time of the Minecraft world (e.g. night time 13000 to 24000).

parameters.value: integer or range object with min and max (e.g. {'min': 13000, 'max': 24000})

name: random_chance
description: Checks if a random float between 0.0 and 1.0 is less than the specified probability.

name: entity_properties
description: Checks properties, flags, or entity types of a target entity (e.g. player is sneaking, mob type).

parameters.predicate: entity predicate object with flags or type

name: match_tool
description: Checks the tool or item used in an action against item predicate criteria.

parameters.predicate: item predicate object with items or count

name: location_check
description: Checks the location, biome, or coordinates of the execution context.

name: all_of
description: Composite condition that passes only when all nested sub-predicate terms pass.

name: any_of
description: Composite condition that passes when at least one nested sub-predicate term passes.

name: inverted
description: Inverts the result of a single nested predicate condition object.

name: reference
description: Invokes another predicate by namespace and path identifier.
